name: OfferKit – Product Bundle Offers for WooCommerce
author: wpvoid

sections.description:
OfferKit lets you package products into fixed kits that sell as a single offer, with a storefront form shoppers can configure and parent/child lines that stay accurate through cart, checkout, and orders.

Free features

  • Fixed product bundles Package products into a kit that sells as one offer with a clear discount.
  • Guided offer wizard Create and publish kits step by step, with a live storefront preview.
  • Product-page storefront UI Shoppers configure and buy the kit on the product page.
  • Quantities and variations Let customers adjust quantities and choose variations where you allow it.
  • Cart, checkout, and order integrity Keep parent and child lines accurate from cart through to the order.
  • Style presets Apply basic storefront colours, presets, and per-offer styling.
  • JSON import / export Back up and restore bundle configuration as JSON.
  • Overview tools Local order and revenue counters, diagnostics, and privacy policy suggestions.

Pro features

  • ⭐ Volume / quantity discounts Offer tiered “buy more, save more” pricing on your kits.
  • ⭐ Complementary product offers Suggest companion products on a host product page.
  • ⭐ Gift with purchase Attach a free or discounted gift when customers buy a product.
  • ⭐ Dynamic campaigns Run conditional product-page campaigns with targeting rules.
  • ⭐ Offer scheduling Show offers only between start and end dates you choose.
  • ⭐ Shortcodes and blocks Place offers with the OfferKit shortcode or Gutenberg block.
  • ⭐ Analytics dashboard Track offer performance beyond the free Overview counters.
  • ⭐ CSV bulk import / export Move configurations in bulk with CSV (JSON remains free).

External services

OfferKit uses Freemius for optional usage opt-in, account and licence management.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the offerkit-bundle-offers-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Product Bundles and use Create offer to build your first kit.
sections.faq:
Does OfferKit require WooCommerce?

Yes. OfferKit is a WooCommerce extension and will not run without it.

How do I create a bundle?

Go to WooCommerce → Product Bundles, then open Create offer. The wizard walks you through naming the kit, choosing products, and publishing it.

Can customers choose quantities or variations?

Yes, when you allow it in the bundle settings. Shoppers can adjust quantities and pick variations on the product page before adding the kit to the cart.

Does inventory update for the items inside a kit?

Yes. When a kit is purchased, OfferKit keeps parent and child order lines linked so stock for the included products can be handled correctly.
